metadata.fog:note: Forked from Stadia alidade_smooth. GRASS board (Phase 1.8) then EXTREME DECLUTTER (Phase 1.9/1.10) then FOREST→SPRITE (Phase 1.12). Line families: ROADS and the COASTLINE are the only VISIBLE strokes. Phase 1.11 also adds same-color 'rounding' outlines (line-color == the fill's own hex, round cap+join, z13 4px→z16 12px) on the greens (landuse_residential_round #9AD483; landcover_park_round #57A951) and water (water_round #4FB2E5): because each stroke is drawn in its own fill's color, tile-seam and interior-boundary segments stay invisible, while the round join fattens+rounds every convex corner where the polygon meets a DIFFERENT color (grass vs background, water vs land) and the line thickness fills small concave notches — a pure-style fake bevel with no real geometry change. First-attempt widths, screenshot-tunable. Colors come from src/config/lowpolyPalette.ts (PALETTE is the single source of truth — keep hexes in sync). {STADIA_API_KEY} is substituted at runtime by mapConfig.ts. Ground: background grassBase, lighter residential/commercial landuse (grassLight), darker leisure-park landcover ONLY (grassDark, landcover subclass=park). Phase 1.12 RETIRED the organic dark-green blobs — park source-layer (nature_reserve/national_park, e.g. Bukit Timah) and landcover class=wood (forest) are NO LONGER drawn: their jagged real boundaries bloated under the Phase 1.11 round-outline trick and dominated the frame, so they now fall through to grassBase and will read as forest via dense tree sprites in Phase 2 (see src/config/buildProps.ts), not as a darker fill. Water is a polygon fill only — waterway LINES (stream/canal/drain/river) are GONE; major rivers survive as water polygons. Small water (swimming_pool) hidden below z16. Paved special ground kept as fills: parking, pedestrian plaza, sand. Buildings: flat terracotta-roof fills (z14+), governed by BUILDINGS_VISIBLE in mapConfig.ts (not by this file's declutter rules). ROADS (Phase 1.10): ONE flat color (roadFill #CDD1D6), round cap+join so intersections merge seamlessly — NO casing, NO dashed centerline, NO per-grade tint. Exactly two width tiers: road_major (motorway/trunk/primary/secondary) z13 3px→z16 10px; road_local (tertiary/minor) from z14.5, z16 5px. Ramps/links (ramp=1), service, track, unclassified, railway all removed. Removed vs Phase 1.8: waterway, park/landcover outlines, landuse_sports, road casings, road_centerline, railway base+ties. Removed in Phase 1.12: park_fill + park_round (nature_reserve/national_park), landcover_wood (forest), and the wood arm of the former landcover_green_round (renamed landcover_park_round, now subclass=park only). Layer order bottom→top; fills first, then each *_round outline sits directly above its OWN fill (so later fills — water, buildings — still paint over it), and coastline + roads are the only strokes that read as lines, sitting on top. CLAY TEXTURE PASS (Phase 1.13): a single top-left light source, so every drop shadow offsets toward bottom-right [+2.5,+3] in VIEWPORT space (screen-fixed under pitch, never map-space). (1) Road drop shadows: road_local_shadow/road_major_shadow are duplicates of their road, drawn directly BELOW it, line-color grassShadow #5E9B4E (shadow on grass = a darker grass tone, NEVER black), same width, line-translate [2.5,3] anchor=viewport, opacity 0.55 as a blur stand-in — the road lifts off the grass as a laid-on ribbon. (3) Water cliff replaces the old flat waterEdge coastline with a 2-line edge: water_cliff (cream #F3EAD5 = cliffEdge, z13 2px→z16 6px) rides the boundary, water_cliff_shadow (#2E86B8 waterCliffShadow, width +2px, line-offset pushed into the water, opacity 0.35) sits under+outside it — land reads as raised above a lower water plane. line-offset SIGN is screenshot-tunable: if the dark band lands on the LAND side, negate the offset stops. (2) landcover_park_shadow duplicates the park fill BELOW it, fill-color #5E9B4E, fill-translate [2.5,3] anchor=viewport, opacity 0.5. CAVEAT: landcover_park_round (grassDark bevel, up to 6px/side at z16) can overhang and swallow the ~3px park shadow at high zoom — if it reads invisible on screenshot, widen the offset or trim park_round. (4) Vignette is an RN overlay (src/components/Vignette.tsx), NOT a style layer. (5) grass noise texture: SKIPPED (low payoff vs sprite-registration cost).
